prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a lively beach scene with sharp details and natural lighting. On the left, a muscular man in black swim trunks lifts a heavy cooler, his muscles tense as he carries it across the hot sand. Next to him, a child in a green swimsuit runs toward a colorful beach ball rolling near the water's edge. In the center, a woman wearing a wide-brimmed hat applies sunscreen to her shoulder, looking into a handheld mirror. Behind her, a teenage boy builds a tower of smooth stones, carefully balancing each rock. To the right, a couple sits on a striped towel, sharing a sandwich from a paper wrapper. A surfboard leans against a nearby palm tree trunk, casting a long shadow. In the background, turquoise waves crash against the shore under a bright blue sky with scattered cumulus clouds. The sunlight is harsh and direct, creating high contrast and vivid colors. Every grain of sand and droplet of water is rendered with crisp clarity. The composition balances dynamic movement with static relaxation, capturing a typical summer day. The style is a photorealistic photo, emphasizing texture and realistic light behavior.
